entries.2166d06044982d7c: Under the 14th Three-Year Plan (fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025), the company worked to solve social issues with "Creating a safe, secure and comfortable society" as its value standard, and aimed to improve production efficiency, viewing environmental changes as growth opportunities. The 15th Three-Year Plan (fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028) that follows sets out concrete reductions in the company's own CO2 emissions in response to climate change, views customers' CO2 reduction efforts as opportunities and develops business strategy accordingly, and advances product development of water-based paints and other measures to curb environmental load substances (such as VOCs) and work to expand product sales. The issues it lists to address are rebuilding its earnings base through optimization of its business portfolio, strengthening personnel, strengthening research and development aimed at solving social issues and creating new value, strengthening its BCP framework, and improving factory productivity and renewing its factories.
